troubleshooting.symptom: High latency with healthy CPU and memory
first_checks: Inspect downstream dependency latency
Check connection pool saturation per pod
Review database wait events and active connection count
common_causes: Connection pool exhaustion
Lock contention
Slow downstream dependency
troubleshooting.escalate_when: Pool and dependency metrics look normal and latency stays above the error budget burn threshold.

troubleshooting.symptom: Outage continues after the triggering event has ended
first_checks: Measure request amplification across the call chain
Check retry counts per hop and whether a retry budget is enforced
Look for queue growth that outlasts the original fault
common_causes: Retry storm
Thundering herd on cache expiry
Cascading queue collapse
troubleshooting.escalate_when: Traffic rate stays elevated after client retries stop.

troubleshooting.symptom: MySQL deadlocks under concurrent batch updates
first_checks: Check SHOW ENGINE INNODB STATUS for recent deadlock graphs
Verify foreign key index coverage on updating tables
Inspect transaction isolation levels and lock wait timeout settings
common_causes: Unindexed foreign key columns causing table scans
Inconsistent lock acquisition ordering across worker threads
Long-running transactions holding row locks
troubleshooting.escalate_when: Deadlock count exceeds 5 per minute or causes user transaction failure spikes.

troubleshooting.symptom: Redis cache eviction spike & thundering herd
first_checks: Check Redis memory usage and evicted_keys metric
Verify TTL jitter configuration on cached items
Inspect backend DB query spikes matching evicted cache keys
common_causes: Bulk expiration of cache keys without random jitter
Maxmemory policy set to volatile-lru instead of allkeys-lru
Large hot key access spike during sale event
troubleshooting.escalate_when: Cache hit ratio drops below 80% and database CPU exceeds 85%.

troubleshooting.symptom: Kafka consumer group lag accumulation during peak hours
first_checks: Inspect kafka_consumergroup_lag per partition
Check consumer pod CPU utilization and garbage collection pauses
Verify partition count matches active consumer thread count
common_causes: Under-partitioned topic limiting consumer parallelism
Blocking HTTP call inside message processing loop
Consumer rebalance loop triggered by heartbeat timeout
troubleshooting.escalate_when: Consumer lag exceeds 100,000 messages and processing latency breaches 5 minutes.

troubleshooting.symptom: Pod CrashLoopBackOff due to OOMKilled in Kubernetes
first_checks: Run kubectl describe pod and check last state termination reason
Review memory metrics history prior to pod termination
Check heap dump or memory profiler logs
common_causes: Memory leak in unclosed HTTP connection streams
Container memory limit set lower than JVM maximum heap size
Unbounded in-memory caching of large payload responses
troubleshooting.escalate_when: More than 20% of service pods enter CrashLoopBackOff simultaneously.

troubleshooting.symptom: SSL certificate expiration & upstream TLS handshake failures
first_checks: Inspect cert-manager certificate status and expiration date
Check ingress controller logs for TLS handshake error codes
Verify intermediate CA chain completeness
common_causes: Automated Let's Encrypt ACME challenge failure due to firewall rule
Expired internal root CA certificate in trust store
Mismatched SNI hostname configuration
troubleshooting.escalate_when: TLS errors affect external customer traffic or public API gateways.

troubleshooting.symptom: DNS resolution timeouts under high VPC connection load
first_checks: Check CoreDNS pod log files for query timeout warnings
Inspect local NodeLocal DNSCache pod status and metrics
Verify AWS Route53 resolver ENI connection limits
common_causes: CoreDNS pod CPU throttling during traffic spikes
UDP packet drop due to socket buffer overflow
Excessive external DNS lookups without local caching
troubleshooting.escalate_when: DNS lookup latency exceeds 50ms across multiple node pools.

postmortems.title: 2026-01-15 Checkout service connection pool exhaustion
postmortems.impact: 45 minute degradation on checkout flow affecting 8% of transactions during evening peak.
postmortems.root_cause: A slow third-party payment gateway call held open database connections in the main request thread until worker pools were exhausted.
corrective_actions: Isolated payment gateway calls into an asynchronous background queue
Enforced strict 2-second HTTP timeouts on all external integrations
Implemented ProxySQL pool limits to cap per-service DB connections

postmortems.title: 2025-11-20 Global DNS routing misconfiguration during migration
postmortems.impact: 18 minutes of 502 errors for APAC traffic during cross-region traffic migration.
postmortems.root_cause: Route53 weighted routing record update omitted the health check association, routing traffic to an unprimed secondary cluster.
corrective_actions: Added automated Terraform validation for DNS health check bindings
Enforced canary DNS weight shifting (5% -> 25% -> 100%)
Updated regional failover runbook with double-confirmation checklist

postmortems.title: 2025-08-14 Redis cluster failover cascade during traffic surge
postmortems.impact: 32 minute outage on user session authentication during promotional campaign.
postmortems.root_cause: Primary Redis node OOM panic triggered failover while replica was loading snapshot, creating a failover loop.
corrective_actions: Upgraded Redis cluster nodes to double memory capacity
Configured maxmemory-policy allkeys-lru with strict eviction limits
Added session fallback store in DynamoDB for auth redundancy

postmortems.title: 2025-05-02 Unindexed query lock contention in payments DB
postmortems.impact: 22 minute latency spike on payment settlement processing.
postmortems.root_cause: A newly deployed reporting query performed a full table scan on the transactions table, acquiring exclusive gap locks.
corrective_actions: Created composite index on (tenant_id, status, created_at)
Enforced read-only replica routing for all reporting and analytics queries
Added automated index verification check to CI database migration linter

postmortems.title: 2025-02-18 Kafka broker disk saturation outage
postmortems.impact: 14 minutes of delayed event logging and real-time analytics stream backlog.
postmortems.root_cause: Topic retention policy misconfiguration set log retention to 30 days instead of 7 days on high-throughput audit topic.
corrective_actions: Standardized Kafka topic retention policies via GitOps infrastructure code
Configured disk usage alert firing at 75% capacity
Implemented automated segment deletion script for emergency disk cleanup

postmortems.title: 2024-12-10 Ingress gateway memory leak after config reload
postmortems.impact: Intermittent 503 gateway errors over 2 hours during continuous delivery deployments.
postmortems.root_cause: Lua plugin in Envoy proxy failed to release memory references upon dynamic route configuration reload.
corrective_actions: Patched Envoy ingress gateway to latest stable release
Replaced custom Lua plugin with native Rust Wasm filter
Added memory growth anomaly detector to ingress gateway alerting

postmortems.title: 2024-09-05 Third-party API rate limit cascade during promo sale
postmortems.impact: 35 minute shopping cart checkout disruption affecting international orders.
postmortems.root_cause: Address verification vendor enforced an undocumented 100 req/sec rate limit without returning HTTP 429 retry-after headers.
corrective_actions: Implemented client-side token bucket rate limiter for external vendor APIs
Added graceful fallback to skip address verification during vendor outages
Renegotiated enterprise SLA with vendor to support 1,000 req/sec peak

troubleshooting.symptom: Intermittent differential protection relay trips during heavy rain
first_checks: Inspect marshalling kiosk cable glands for water ingress
Measure CT secondary circuit resistance and unbalance
Correlate trip timestamps against local rainfall and load curve
common_causes: Cracked cable gland permitting moisture entry into marshalling box
Intermittent CT secondary short-circuit
Moisture-induced insulation degradation
troubleshooting.escalate_when: CT secondary unbalance persists after kiosk resealing.

troubleshooting.symptom: SCADA polling gaps and telemetry packet loss
first_checks: Inspect serial-to-Ethernet gateway latency
Verify DNP3 response timeout and retry counts
Check cellular router signal quality (RSSI/RSRP) at remote substation
common_causes: Cellular modem signal degradation during adverse weather
Buffer overflow on serial communication card
Unbounded DNP3 retries clogging narrow band channel
troubleshooting.escalate_when: Telemetry drop exceeds 15 minutes on transmission tie-lines.

troubleshooting.symptom: Grid frequency telemetry jitter in Flink pipeline
first_checks: Check MQTT broker incoming packet rate and socket buffer queue
Verify Flink task manager garbage collection pause times
Inspect NTP time synchronization drift across telemetry gateways
common_causes: NTP clock drift exceeding 50ms on edge gateways
Flink window size set smaller than maximum network jitter
MQTT message backlog on partition leader
troubleshooting.escalate_when: Sub-second frequency calculation delay exceeds 2 seconds.

troubleshooting.symptom: Battery energy storage system (BESS) thermal warning
first_checks: Check coolant pump flow rate and chiller temperature
Inspect individual cell voltage and temperature sensors for outliers
Verify ambient HVAC operation in battery enclosure
common_causes: Coolant line air lock reducing thermal dissipation
Cell internal resistance imbalance causing localized heating
HVAC filter clogging in desert environment
troubleshooting.escalate_when: Cell temperature exceeds 45°C or rate of temperature rise exceeds 2°C/min.

troubleshooting.symptom: SF6 gas pressure low alarm on 220kV circuit breaker
first_checks: Read density monitor gauge and compensate for ambient temperature
Inspect gas piping joints and pressure relief valves for leaks
Check breaker trip interlock circuit status
common_causes: Valve seal degradation due to thermal expansion cycles
Slow micro-leakage in pressure sensor fitting
Temperature compensation circuit failure
troubleshooting.escalate_when: Gas pressure drops below stage-2 lockout threshold (4.5 bar).

troubleshooting.symptom: Auto-recloser lockout after transient lightning fault
first_checks: Read event record and fault location distance calculation from relay
Inspect overhead line surge arresters and insulator strings
Check recloser reclosure attempt counter and sequence timer
common_causes: Permanent line fault (tree branch contact)
Surge arrester failure causing permanent ground fault
Recloser timing sequence misconfiguration
troubleshooting.escalate_when: Line fails to reclose after 3 automatic attempts.

postmortems.title: 2025-10-12 Intermittent 220kV transformer differential trips
postmortems.impact: Three unplanned transformer trips over 3 weeks during evening load peak.
postmortems.root_cause: Cracked cable gland in marshalling kiosk allowed rainwater ingress, intermittently shorting CT secondary wiring.
corrective_actions: Replaced damaged cable gland and re-sealed marshalling kiosk enclosure
Added weather correlation plotting protocol to initial troubleshooting checklist
Cancelled planned $45k transformer oil analysis outage after root cause confirmation

postmortems.title: 2025-06-04 SCADA master gateway failover telemetry gap
postmortems.impact: 12 minute loss of real-time substation monitoring during storm front.
postmortems.root_cause: Primary SCADA server virtual machine memory exhaustion triggered failover before secondary standby DB state was synchronized.
corrective_actions: Implemented hot-standby active-active state replication for SCADA gateways
Increased virtual machine RAM allocation from 16GB to 64GB
Added automated heart-beat health check with 3-second failover threshold

postmortems.title: 2025-01-22 Battery storage inverter trip during frequency response
postmortems.impact: 20MW rapid frequency response capacity unavailable for 25 minutes during grid frequency dip.
postmortems.root_cause: DC bus over-voltage protection trip caused by aggressive inverter ramp rate setting under low grid impedance.
corrective_actions: Tuned inverter active power dP/dt ramp rate limiters
Updated battery management system firmware to v4.2.1
Conducted hardware-in-the-loop simulation tests for extreme grid frequency events

postmortems.title: 2024-08-30 Solar farm feeder over-voltage protection trip
postmortems.impact: 50MW solar generation curtailment during peak midday generation.
postmortems.root_cause: Distribution grid voltage rise at tap changer limit due to cloud cover clearing combined with light local load.
corrective_actions: Enabled dynamic reactive power (Volt-VAR) control on solar inverters
Updated substation transformer automatic tap changer response curve
Integrated solar irradiance forecast feed into SCADA voltage control loop

postmortems.title: 2024-04-18 Substation optical fiber ground wire (OPGW) break
postmortems.impact: Loss of differential protection channel between Substation A and Substation B.
postmortems.root_cause: Physical OPGW fiber damage caused by storm-driven tree branch impact on span 42.
corrective_actions: Spliced damaged OPGW optical fibers and restored channel in 4 hours
Activated backup microwave communications link for protection signaling
Trimmed right-of-way vegetation along 15km transmission corridor
